/-- Twisting by `e(αu)` translates the Fourier transform. -/
theorem fourier_mul_e (f : ℝ → ℂ) (α ξ : ℝ) :
    𝓕 (fun u => f u * e (α * u)) ξ = 𝓕 f (ξ - α) := by
  rw [fourier_eq_integral_e, fourier_eq_integral_e]
  congr 1; funext v
  rw [mul_comm (f v), ← mul_assoc, ← e_add]; congr 2; ring

proof_context.conclusion: `𝓕 (f·e(α·)) ξ = 𝓕 f (ξ-α)`, the twist by `e(αu)` translates the Fourier transform.

/-- `∑_{n ∈ ℤ} 1/(n - s)² = π²/sin²(πs)` for `s ∉ ℤ`, via Parseval for `e(sx)` on `[0, 1]`. -/
theorem hasSum_inv_sq_sub {s : ℝ} (hs : Real.sin (π * s) ≠ 0) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℤ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) - s) ^ 2) (π ^ 2 / Real.sin (π * s) ^ 2) := by
  have hsn : ∀ n : ℤ, s ≠ n := by
    intro n h; apply hs; rw [h, mul_comm]; exact Real.sin_int_mul_pi n
  have hL2 : MemLp (fun x : ℝ => e (s * x)) 2 (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc 0 1)) :=
    MemLp.of_bound ((continuous_e.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable)
      1 (ae_of_all _ fun x => by simp [norm_e])
  have h := hasSum_sq_fourierCoeffOn zero_lt_one hL2
  simp only [norm_e, one_pow, intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, inv_one,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h
  have hterm : ∀ n : ℤ, ‖fourierCoeffOn zero_lt_one (fun x => e (s * x)) n‖ ^ 2 =
      Real.sin (π * s) ^ 2 / π ^ 2 * (1 / ((n : ℝ) - s) ^ 2) := by
    intro n
    have hne : (s : ℝ) - n ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 (hsn n)
    rw [fourierCoeffOn_e_mul n (hsn n), norm_div, div_pow, norm_e_sub_one_sq]
    have : ‖(2 * π * I * ((s : ℂ) - n))‖ = 2 * π * |s - n| := by
      have h1 : ((s : ℂ) - n) = ((s - n : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [h1, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_I,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos, Complex.norm_ofNat, mul_one]
    rw [this]
    have : (n - s) ^ 2 = |s - n| ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs]; ring
    rw [this]
    have := abs_pos.2 hne
    field_simp
    ring
  simp_rw [hterm] at h
  have hk : Real.sin (π * s) ^ 2 / π ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have := h.mul_left (π ^ 2 / Real.sin (π * s) ^ 2)
  convert this using 1
  · funext n; rw [← mul_assoc, div_mul_div_comm, mul_comm (π ^ 2), div_self (by positivity), one_mul]
  · ring

proof_context.conclusion: `∑_{n∈ℤ} 1/(n-s)² = π²/sin²(πs)` for `sin πs ≠ 0`, proved via Parseval for `e(sx)` on `[0,1]`.

set N := ⌊y⌋
  have hfl : ⌊y + q⌋ = N + q := by
    have := Int.floor_add_intCast y (q : ℤ); push_cast at this; exact this
  rw [hfl]
  set S := Finset.Ioc N (N + q)
  set c : ℝ := N + (q + 1) / 2
  have hdist : ∀ n ∈ S, |(n : ℝ) - c| ≤ q / 2 := by
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_Ioc] at hn
    have h1 : (N : ℝ) + 1 ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : N + 1 ≤ n)
    have h2 : (n : ℝ) ≤ N + q := by exact_mod_cast hn.2
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> simp only [c] <;> linarith

proof_context.conclusion: Sets c = N + (q+1)/2 with N = ⌊y⌋ and shows every n in Ioc N (N+q) has |n-c| ≤ q/2 (the centred index j = n-c).

verification.reason: Lean centres at the real c = ⌊y⌋+(q+1)/2 (a half-integer for even q) and works with the closed window |n-c| ≤ q/2 and round(βc/Q), not the integer m_0 = ⌊y⌋+⌊(q+1)/2⌋ with j ∈ (-q/2,q/2]; the difference enters the set-up step's own claim, so analogue rule gives relatedMatch.

set w := β * c / Q
  set c₀ := round w
  set s₀ := w - c₀
  have hs₀ : |s₀| ≤ 1 / 2 := abs_sub_round w
  set τn := fun n : ℤ => s₀ + β * (n - c) / Q
  have hsmall : ∀ n ∈ S, |β * (n - c) / Q| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    intro n hn
    rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hQ0, div_le_iff₀ hQ0]
    calc |β| * |(n : ℝ) - c| ≤ 1 * (q / 2) :=
          mul_le_mul hβ (hdist n hn) (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
      _ ≤ 1 / 2 * Q := by linarith
  have hkey : ∀ n : ℤ, π * α * n = π * ((a * n + c₀ : ℤ) + τn n) / q := by
    intro n
    simp only [τn, s₀, w, hα]
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring

-- Choose the orientation `σ = ±1` so that `s = σ s₀ ≥ 0`.
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ, hσs⟩ : ∃ σ : ℤ, σ * σ = 1 ∧ 0 ≤ (σ : ℝ) * s₀ := by
    rcases le_or_gt 0 s₀ with h0 | h0
    · exact ⟨1, by norm_num, by simpa using h0⟩
    · exact ⟨-1, by norm_num, by push_cast; linarith⟩
  have hσr : (σ : ℝ) * σ = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hσ
  have hσabs : |(σ : ℝ)| = 1 := by
    have : |(σ : ℝ)| * |(σ : ℝ)| = 1 := by rw [← abs_mul, hσr, abs_one]
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg (σ : ℝ)]
  set s := (σ : ℝ) * s₀
  have hs1 : s ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    calc s ≤ |s| := le_abs_self _
      _ = |s₀| := by simp only [s, abs_mul, hσabs, one_mul]
      _ ≤ 1 / 2 := hs₀
  set τ' := fun n : ℤ => (σ : ℝ) * τn n
  have hτ' : ∀ n ∈ S, τ' n ∈ Icc (s - 1 / 2) (s + 1 / 2) := by
    intro n hn
    have hb := hsmall n hn
    have : |(σ : ℝ) * (β * (n - c) / Q)| ≤ 1 / 2 := by rw [abs_mul, hσabs, one_mul]; exact hb
    rw [abs_le] at this
    simp only [τ', τn, s, mul_add, mem_Icc]
    constructor <;> linarith [this.1, this.2]

proof_context.conclusion: Orientation `σ = ±1` makes `s = σ s₀ ≥ 0`, `s ≤ 1/2`, and `τ' n ∈ [s-1/2, s+1/2]`.

have hinj : Set.InjOn R S := by
    intro n hn n' hn' hR
    have hmod : m n % q = m n' % q := by rw [← hRcast, ← hRcast]; exact congrArg _ hR
    have hdvd : (q : ℤ) ∣ a * (n - n') := by
      have h1 : (q : ℤ) ∣ m n - m n' := Int.ModEq.dvd hmod.symm
      have : m n - m n' = σ * (a * (n - n')) := by simp only [m]; ring
      rw [this] at h1
      have h2 : (q : ℤ) ∣ σ * (σ * (a * (n - n'))) := dvd_mul_of_dvd_right h1 σ
      rwa [← mul_assoc, hσ, one_mul] at h2
    have hd : (q : ℤ) ∣ n - n' := hcop.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hdvd
    simp only [S, Finset.coe_Ioc, Set.mem_Ioc] at hn hn'
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hd
    have : t = 0 := by
      by_contra ht0
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne ht0 with h | h
      · have : (q : ℤ) * t ≤ -q := by nlinarith
        omega
      · have : (q : ℤ) ≤ q * t := by nlinarith
        omega
    subst this; omega
  have hτR : ∀ n ∈ S, τR (R n) = τ' n := by
    intro n hn
    have hex : ∃ n' ∈ S, R n' = R n := ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
    simp only [τR, dite_eq_left hex]
    have := hex.choose_spec
    rw [hinj this.1 hn this.2]
  refine ⟨s, hσs, hs1, τR, fun r => ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [τR]
    split_ifs with hr
    · exact hτ' _ hr.choose_spec.1
    · exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  · rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => hterm n]
    refine Finset.sum_nbij R (fun n _ => Finset.mem_range.2 (hRlt n)) hinj ?_ ?_
    · have hcard : (Finset.range q).card ≤ S.card := by
        simp only [S, Int.card_Ioc, Finset.card_range]; omega
      intro r hr
      obtain ⟨n, hn, hrn⟩ := Finset.surj_on_of_inj_on_of_card_le (fun n _ => R n)
        (fun n _ => Finset.mem_range.2 (hRlt n)) (fun n n' hn hn' h => hinj hn hn' h) hcard r hr
      exact ⟨n, hn, hrn.symm⟩
    · intro n hn; rw [hτR n hn]

proof_context.conclusion: The map `n ↦ R n = (σ(a n + c₀)) mod q` is injective on `S` (by `(a,q)=1`) hence a bijection onto `range q`, so each residue occurs once.

have hFC : ∀ R : ℕ, 1 ≤ R → R + 2 ≤ q →
      minA A C (Real.sin (π * (R + τ R) / q) ^ 2) ≤ C * fq q (R + τ R) := by
    intro R h1 h2
    have hR1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ R := by exact_mod_cast h1
    have hR2 : (R : ℝ) + 2 ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast h2
    obtain ⟨t1, t2⟩ := hτ R
    have hpos : 0 < Real.sin (π * (R + τ R) / q) := by
      apply Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi
      · apply div_pos (mul_pos Real.pi_pos (by linarith)) hq0
      · rw [div_lt_iff₀ hq0]; nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
    unfold minA
    rw [if_neg (by positivity)]

/-- Pairing ("majorization"): for convex `f` and `a ≤ b ≤ c ≤ d` with `b + c = a + d`,
`f b + f c ≤ f a + f d`. -/
theorem _root_.ConvexOn.add_le_add_of_majorize {s : Set ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ConvexOn ℝ s f)
    {a b c d : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ s) (hd : d ∈ s) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hcd : c ≤ d)
    (hsum : b + c = a + d) : f b + f c ≤ f a + f d := by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hab.trans (hbc.trans hcd)) with had | had
  · have : a = b := le_antisymm hab (by linarith)
    have : c = d := le_antisymm hcd (by linarith)
    subst_vars; rfl
  have hda : d - a ≠ 0 := (sub_pos.2 had).ne'
  have hc' : c = a + d - b := by linarith
  set l := (d - b) / (d - a)
  have hl0 : 0 ≤ l := div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hl1 : l ≤ 1 := (div_le_one (by linarith)).2 (by linarith)
  have hb : l • a + (1 - l) • d = b := by
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, l]; field_simp; ring
  have hc : (1 - l) • a + l • d = c := by
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, l]; rw [hc']; field_simp; ring
  have h1 : f (l • a + (1 - l) • d) ≤ l • f a + (1 - l) • f d :=
    hf.2 ha hd hl0 (by linarith) (by ring)
  have h2 : f ((1 - l) • a + l • d) ≤ (1 - l) • f a + l • f d :=
    hf.2 ha hd (by linarith) hl0 (by ring)
  rw [hb] at h1; rw [hc] at h2
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h1 h2
  linarith

proof_context.conclusion: For convex `f`, `a ≤ b ≤ c ≤ d`, `b+c=a+d`: `f b + f c ≤ f a + f d`.

    hc.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by linarith)

      rw [show Finset.Icc 1 K \ {1} = Finset.Ico 2 (K + 1) by ext x; simp; omega,
        Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sum_range, show K + 1 - 2 = K - 1 by omega]
      refine add_le_add (hGA _) ?_
      have := sum_G_le (u₁ := 3 / 2) (m := K - 1) hq0 hA hC (by norm_num)
        (by rw [Nat.cast_sub hK]; push_cast; linarith)

      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      simp only [G]; push_cast; ring_nf

    rw [h4]
    linarith

proof_context.conclusion: Second bound: each family sum of G is at most (2q/pi)sqrt(AC) (plus A for the half-integer family), so the total is at most 2A+(4q/pi)sqrt(AC).

/-- **I2.** For unit-spaced points `u₁, u₁ + 1, …, u₁ + m - 1` in `[1, q/2]`,
`∑ min(A, C f_q(u)) ≤ (2q/π) √(AC)`. -/
theorem sum_G_le {q A C : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hC : 0 ≤ C) {u₁ : ℝ} {m : ℕ}
    (hu₁ : 1 ≤ u₁) (hlast : u₁ + m - 1 ≤ q / 2) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, min A (C * fq q (u₁ + i)) ≤ 2 * (q / π) * √(A * C) := by
  set G := fun u => min A (C * fq q u)
  have hG0 : ∀ u, 0 ≤ G u := fun u => le_min hA (mul_nonneg hC (fq_nonneg q u))
  have hII : ∀ a b, IntervalIntegrable G volume a b := intervalIntegrable_G hA hC
  -- Each term is at most the integral over the unit interval to its left.
  have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range m,
      G (u₁ + i) ≤ ∫ u in (u₁ - 1 + i)..(u₁ - 1 + (i + 1 : ℕ)), G u := by
    intro i hi
    have hi' : (i : ℝ) + 1 ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast Finset.mem_range.1 hi
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by push_cast; linarith)]
    have hvol : volume.real (Ioc (u₁ - 1 + i) (u₁ - 1 + (i + 1 : ℕ))) = 1 := by
      rw [Real.volume_real_Ioc_of_le (by push_cast; linarith)]; push_cast; ring
    calc G (u₁ + i) = ∫ _ in Ioc (u₁ - 1 + i) (u₁ - 1 + (i + 1 : ℕ)), G (u₁ + i) := by
          rw [setIntegral_const, hvol, one_smul]
      _ ≤ _ := by
          refine setIntegral_mono_on continuous_const.integrableOn_Ioc ((hII _ _).1) measurableSet_Ioc
            fun v hv => ?_
          simp only [mem_Ioc] at hv; push_cast at hv
          exact min_le_min le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (fq_anti hq (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)) hC)
  have hsum := intervalIntegral.sum_integral_adjacent_intervals (μ := volume) (f := G)
    (a := fun i : ℕ => u₁ - 1 + i) (n := m) fun i _ => hII _ _
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] at hsum
  -- Compare with `∫₀^{q/2} G`.
  have hsub : ∫ u in (u₁ - 1)..(u₁ - 1 + m), G u ≤ ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..(q / 2), G u := by
    have e1 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (a := 0) (b := u₁ - 1)
      (c := q / 2) (hII 0 (u₁ - 1)) (hII (u₁ - 1) (q / 2))
    have e2 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (a := u₁ - 1) (b := u₁ - 1 + m)
      (c := q / 2) (hII (u₁ - 1) (u₁ - 1 + m)) (hII (u₁ - 1 + m) (q / 2))
    have h1 := intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (μ := volume) (a := 0) (b := u₁ - 1)
      (by linarith) fun u _ => hG0 u
    have h2 := intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (μ := volume) (a := u₁ - 1 + m) (b := q / 2)
      (by linarith) fun u _ => hG0 u
    linarith
  -- Change of variables `v = πu/q`.
  have hcv : ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..(q / 2), G u =
      q / π * ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..(π / 2), min A (C * (1 / Real.sin v ^ 2)) := by
    have hpq : π / q ≠ 0 := (div_pos Real.pi_pos hq).ne'
    have : G = fun u => (fun v => min A (C * (1 / Real.sin v ^ 2))) ((π / q) * u) := by
      funext u; simp only [G, fq]; ring_nf
    rw [this, intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left _ hpq, smul_eq_mul, inv_div]
    congr 2 <;> field_simp <;> simp
  calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, G (u₁ + i)
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, ∫ u in (u₁ - 1 + i)..(u₁ - 1 + (i + 1 : ℕ)), G u :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
    _ = ∫ u in (u₁ - 1)..(u₁ - 1 + m), G u := hsum
    _ ≤ ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..(q / 2), G u := hsub
    _ ≤ q / π * (2 * √(A * C)) := by
        rw [hcv]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (integral_minInvSin_le hA hC) (by positivity)
    _ = 2 * (q / π) * √(A * C) := by ring

proof_context.conclusion: A unit-spaced family of min(A, C fq) terms sums to at most (2q/pi)sqrt(AC).

verification.reason: Lean proves the stated 2A + (4q/π)√(AC) by summing sum_G_le over the two families, not by the book's arcsin-counting second approach of Lemma 4.1.1 (itself relatedMatch at Lemma 4.1.1 step 25). The step claims that approach, so relatedMatch; the stated conclusion is not stronger, so broadMatch does not apply.

/-- **Reduction for Lemmas 4.1.2–4.1.3**, for any nonnegative summand `Φ(sin²(παn))`.  For `0 ≤ y₁ < n ≤ y₂ ≤ Q/2`, `q ∤ n`, `y₂ - y₁ ≤ q`, the terms
are bounded by `Φ(sin²(π(R + τ_R)/q))` over distinct residues `R ∈ [1, q-1]`, `τ_R ∈ [0, 1/2]`. -/
theorem residue_form_gen {α Q : ℝ} {a : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (h : Approx α a q Q) {y₁ y₂ : ℝ}
    (hy : 0 ≤ y₁) (hlen : y₂ - y₁ ≤ q) (hy₂ : y₂ ≤ Q / 2) (Φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hΦ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ Φ x) :
    ∃ τ : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ R, τ R ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2)) ∧
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊y₁⌋ ⌊y₂⌋,
          (if (q : ℤ) ∣ n then 0 else Φ (Real.sin (π * α * n) ^ 2)) ≤
        ∑ R ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (q - 1), Φ (Real.sin (π * (R + τ R) / q) ^ 2) := by
  obtain ⟨hq1, hcop, β, hβ, hα, hqQ⟩ := h
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq1
  have hQ0 : 0 < Q := by linarith
  have hqz : (0 : ℤ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq1
  set S := Finset.Ioc ⌊y₁⌋ ⌊y₂⌋
  set S' := S.filter fun n => ¬ (q : ℤ) ∣ n
  have hS : ∀ n ∈ S, 1 ≤ n ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ y₂ := by
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_Ioc] at hn
    have h0 : 0 ≤ ⌊y₁⌋ := Int.floor_nonneg.2 hy
    exact ⟨by omega, (Int.cast_le.2 hn.2).trans (Int.floor_le y₂)⟩
  have hgap : ∀ n ∈ S, ∀ n' ∈ S, n - n' < q := by
    intro n hn n' hn'
    rw [Finset.mem_Ioc] at hn hn'
    have h1 : ((n - n' : ℤ) : ℝ) < q := by
      have a1 : (n : ℝ) ≤ y₂ := (Int.cast_le.2 hn.2).trans (Int.floor_le y₂)
      have a2 : y₁ < n' := by
        have := Int.lt_floor_add_one y₁
        have : ((⌊y₁⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1 ≤ n' := by exact_mod_cast hn'.1
        linarith
      push_cast; linarith
    exact_mod_cast h1
  -- Orientation.
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ, hσβ⟩ : ∃ σ : ℤ, σ * σ = 1 ∧ 0 ≤ (σ : ℝ) * β := by
    rcases le_or_gt 0 β with h0 | h0
    · exact ⟨1, by norm_num, by simpa using h0⟩
    · exact ⟨-1, by norm_num, by push_cast; linarith⟩
  have hσr : (σ : ℝ) * σ = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hσ
  have hσabs : |(σ : ℝ)| = 1 := by
    have : |(σ : ℝ)| * |(σ : ℝ)| = 1 := by rw [← abs_mul, hσr, abs_one]
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg (σ : ℝ)]
  set τ' := fun n : ℤ => (σ : ℝ) * β * n / Q
  have hτ' : ∀ n ∈ S, τ' n ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2) := by
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hS n hn
    have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : (0 : ℤ) ≤ n)
    have hσβ1 : (σ : ℝ) * β ≤ 1 := by
      calc (σ : ℝ) * β ≤ |(σ : ℝ) * β| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |β| := by rw [abs_mul, hσabs, one_mul]
        _ ≤ 1 := hβ
    simp only [τ', mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · positivity
    · rw [div_le_iff₀ hQ0]; nlinarith
  set m := fun n : ℤ => σ * (a * n)
  set R := fun n : ℤ => (m n % (q : ℤ)).toNat
  have hRcast : ∀ n, ((R n : ℕ) : ℤ) = m n % q := fun n =>
    Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Int.emod_nonneg _ hqz.ne')
  have hRlt : ∀ n, R n < q := by
    intro n; simp only [R]
    have h1 := Int.emod_nonneg (m n) hqz.ne'
    have h2 := Int.emod_lt_of_pos (m n) hqz
    omega
  have hRpos : ∀ n ∈ S', 1 ≤ R n := by
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hn
    by_contra h0
    have h00 : m n % q = 0 := by have := hRcast n; omega
    apply hn.2
    have h1 : (q : ℤ) ∣ σ * (a * n) := Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero h00
    have h2 : (q : ℤ) ∣ σ * (σ * (a * n)) := dvd_mul_of_dvd_right h1 σ
    rw [← mul_assoc, hσ, one_mul] at h2
    exact hcop.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left h2
  have hterm : ∀ n : ℤ, Φ (Real.sin (π * α * n) ^ 2) = Φ (Real.sin (π * (R n + τ' n) / q) ^ 2) := by
    intro n
    congr 1
    have hm : a * n = σ * (q * (m n / q) + (R n : ℤ)) := by
      rw [hRcast, Int.mul_ediv_add_emod]; simp only [m]; rw [← mul_assoc, hσ, one_mul]
    have harg : π * α * n = (σ : ℝ) * (π * ((R n : ℝ) + τ' n) / q + ((m n / q : ℤ) : ℝ) * π) := by
      have e : π * α * n = π * (((a * n : ℤ) : ℝ) + β * n / Q) / q := by
        rw [hα]; push_cast; field_simp
      rw [e, hm]; push_cast; simp only [τ']; field_simp; ring_nf
      rw [show (σ : ℝ) ^ 2 = 1 by rw [sq, hσr]]; ring
    rw [harg]
    rcases Int.eq_one_or_neg_one_of_mul_eq_one hσ with hs | hs <;>
    · subst hs; push_cast
      simp only [one_mul, neg_one_mul, Real.sin_neg, neg_sq]
      rw [sin_sq_add_int_mul_pi]
  have hinj : Set.InjOn R S' := by
    intro n hn n' hn' hR
    have hn1 := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hn).1
    have hn1' := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hn').1
    have hmod : m n % q = m n' % q := by rw [← hRcast, ← hRcast]; exact congrArg _ hR
    have hdvd : (q : ℤ) ∣ a * (n - n') := by
      have h1 : (q : ℤ) ∣ m n - m n' := Int.ModEq.dvd hmod.symm
      have : m n - m n' = σ * (a * (n - n')) := by simp only [m]; ring
      rw [this] at h1
      have h2 : (q : ℤ) ∣ σ * (σ * (a * (n - n'))) := dvd_mul_of_dvd_right h1 σ
      rwa [← mul_assoc, hσ, one_mul] at h2
    have hd : (q : ℤ) ∣ n - n' := hcop.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hdvd
    have g1 := hgap n hn1 n' hn1'
    have g2 := hgap n' hn1' n hn1
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hd
    have : t = 0 := by
      by_contra ht0
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne ht0 with h | h
      · have : (q : ℤ) * t ≤ -q := by nlinarith
        omega
      · have : (q : ℤ) ≤ q * t := by nlinarith
        omega
    subst this; omega
  set τR := fun r : ℕ => if hr : ∃ n ∈ S', R n = r then τ' hr.choose else 0
  have hτR : ∀ n ∈ S', τR (R n) = τ' n := by
    intro n hn
    have hex : ∃ n' ∈ S', R n' = R n := ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
    simp only [τR, dite_eq_left hex]
    have := hex.choose_spec
    rw [hinj this.1 hn this.2]
  refine ⟨τR, fun r => ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [τR]
    split_ifs with hr
    · exact hτ' _ (Finset.mem_filter.1 hr.choose_spec.1).1
    · exact ⟨le_rfl, by norm_num⟩
  · set g := fun r : ℕ => Φ (Real.sin (π * (r + τR r) / q) ^ 2)
    have hg0 : ∀ r, 0 ≤ g r := fun r => hΦ _
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter_not_add_sum_filter S (fun n => (q : ℤ) ∣ n)]
    have hzero : ∑ n ∈ S.filter (fun n => (q : ℤ) ∣ n),
        (if (q : ℤ) ∣ n then 0 else Φ (Real.sin (π * α * n) ^ 2)) = 0 :=
      Finset.sum_eq_zero fun n hn => by rw [ite_eq_left (Finset.mem_filter.1 hn).2]
    rw [hzero, add_zero]
    have hS'eq : ∑ n ∈ S', (if (q : ℤ) ∣ n then 0 else Φ (Real.sin (π * α * n) ^ 2)) =
        ∑ n ∈ S', g (R n) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
      rw [ite_eq_right (Finset.mem_filter.1 hn).2, hterm n]
      simp only [g, hτR n hn]
    rw [hS'eq, ← Finset.sum_image (fun n hn n' hn' h => hinj hn hn' h)]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ fun r _ _ => hg0 r
    intro r hr
    obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hr
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]
    exact ⟨hRpos n hn, by have := hRlt n; omega⟩

proof_context.conclusion: For nonnegative Phi, the sum over q-not-dividing n is at most the sum of Phi(sin^2(pi(R+tau_R)/q)) over distinct residues R in [1,q-1], tau_R in [0,1/2].

theorem pair_le_half {n r : ℝ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hr : |r| ≤ 1 / 2) :

  have h1 : 0 < n - r := by linarith [neg_abs_le r, le_abs_self r]
  have h2 : 0 < n + r := by linarith [neg_abs_le r, le_abs_self r]
  have h3 : 0 < n - 1 / 2 := by linarith
  have h4 : 0 < n + 1 / 2 := by linarith
  have E : ∀ t, 0 < n - t → 0 < n + t →
      1 / (n - t) ^ 2 + 1 / (n + t) ^ 2 = 2 * (n ^ 2 + t ^ 2) / (n ^ 2 - t ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
    intro t ht1 ht2
    have : n ^ 2 - t ^ 2 = (n - t) * (n + t) := by ring
    rw [this]; field_simp; ring
  have e1 := E r h1 h2
  have e2 := E (1 / 2) h3 h4
  rw [show ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 = 1 / 4 by norm_num] at e2
  rw [e1, e2]
  have ha : 0 < n ^ 2 - r ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hb : 0 < n ^ 2 - 1 / 4 := by nlinarith
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
  -- `(N+a)(N-b)² ≤ (N+b)(N-a)²` with `a = r² ≤ b = 1/4`, `N = n² ≥ 1`.
  have hN : 1 ≤ n ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have key : (n ^ 2 + 1 / 4) * (n ^ 2 - r ^ 2) ^ 2 - (n ^ 2 + r ^ 2) * (n ^ 2 - 1 / 4) ^ 2 =
      (1 / 4 - r ^ 2) * (3 * (n ^ 2) ^ 2 - n ^ 2 * (r ^ 2 + 1 / 4) - r ^ 2 / 4) := by ring
  have : 0 ≤ (1 / 4 - r ^ 2) * (3 * (n ^ 2) ^ 2 - n ^ 2 * (r ^ 2 + 1 / 4) - r ^ 2 / 4) := by
    apply mul_nonneg (by linarith); nlinarith [sq_nonneg r]
  nlinarith

  have hV := eta2'L1_pos
  have hc0 : (0 : ℝ) < c₀ := by unfold c₀; norm_num
  set J := ⌈(D' - 0) / q⌉₊
  have hblocks := sum_Ioc_le_blocks (G := fun n => if (q : ℤ) ∣ n then 0 else Tn α x n)
    (fun n => by split_ifs; exacts [le_rfl, Tn_nonneg _ _ _]) hq J 0 D' (nblocks_spec hq0)
  refine hblocks.trans ?_
  set A := x / 2 + eta2'L1 / 2
  -- Each block.
  have hblock : ∀ j ∈ range J,
      ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊(0 : ℝ) + j * q⌋ ⌊min ((0 : ℝ) + (j + 1) * q) D'⌋,
          (if (q : ℤ) ∣ n then 0 else Tn α x n) ≤

    intro j _
    set y₁ := (0 : ℝ) + j * q
    set y₂ := min ((0 : ℝ) + (j + 1) * q) D'
    set C := c₀ / 2 * ((0 : ℝ) + (j + 1) * q) / x
    have hbound : 0 ≤ 10 * c₀ * q ^ 3 / (3 * π ^ 2 * x) * ((j : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
    rcases le_or_gt y₂ y₁ with h12 | h12
    · rw [Ioc_eq_empty (not_lt.2 (Int.floor_mono h12))]; simpa using hbound
    have hy₂ : y₂ ≤ Q / 2 := (min_le_right _ _).trans hD'Q
    have h12' := (lemma_4_1_2 happ (y₁ := y₁) (y₂ := y₂) (by positivity) h12

      intro n hn
      split_ifs with hdvd
      · exact le_rfl
      rw [mem_Ioc] at hn

      have hn1 : (0 : ℤ) < n := lt_of_le_of_lt (Int.floor_nonneg.2 hy10) hn.1
      have hnR : (n : ℝ) ≤ y₂ := (Int.cast_le.2 hn.2).trans (Int.floor_le _)
      have hcast : ((n.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = n := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hn1.le
      have hmR : ((n.toNat : ℕ) : ℝ) = n := by exact_mod_cast hcast
      have hm : 1 ≤ n.toNat := by omega
      have hne : Real.sin (π * (a / q + δ / x) * ((n.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ)) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hcast]
        exact sin_ne_zero_of_approx happ hdvd (by
          rw [abs_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hn1)]; linarith)
      have := (norm_Todd_le_min_sin hx h2α hm hne (A := A) (B := eta2'L1 / 2) (C := C)
        (by
          rw [hmR]; simp only [A]
          have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn1
          have : x / (2 * n) ≤ x / 2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hx.le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
          linarith) le_rfl
        (by
          rw [hmR]; simp only [C]
          have : (n : ℝ) ≤ (0 : ℝ) + (j + 1) * q := hnR.trans (min_le_left _ _)
          rw [show c₀ / 2 * ((0 : ℝ) + (j + 1) * q) / x = ((0 : ℝ) + (j + 1) * q) / x * (c₀ / 2)

    _ = _ := by field_simp; ring

theorem norm_Todd_le_minA {α x δ : ℝ} {a k : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (h2α : 2 * α = a / q + δ / x + k) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {A C : ℝ}
    (hA : x / (2 * m) + eta2'L1 / 2 ≤ A) (hC : m / x * (c₀ / 2) ≤ C) :
    ‖Todd α x m‖ ≤ minA A C (Real.sin (π * (a / q + δ / x) * (m : ℤ)) ^ 2) := by
  have hs := sin_sq_two_pi_mul h2α (m : ℝ) ⟨m, by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := norm_Todd_le hx hm α
  push_cast at hs ⊢
  unfold minA
  split_ifs with h0
  · exact h1.trans hA
  · have hne : Real.sin (2 * π * m * α) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; apply h0; rw [← hs, h]; ring
    refine le_min (h1.trans hA) ?_
    refine (h2 hne).2.trans ?_
    rw [hs]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hC (sq_nonneg _)

/-- Split `∑_{⌊a⌋ < n ≤ ⌊b⌋} G(n)` (`G ≥ 0`) into blocks `(a + jq, min(a + (j+1)q, b)]`. -/
theorem sum_Ioc_le_blocks {G : ℤ → ℝ} (hG : ∀ n, 0 ≤ G n) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    ∀ (J : ℕ) (a b : ℝ), b ≤ a + J * q →
      ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊a⌋ ⌊b⌋, G n ≤
        ∑ j ∈ range J, ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊a + j * q⌋ ⌊min (a + (j + 1) * q) b⌋, G n := by
  intro J
  induction J with
  | zero =>
    intro a b hab
    simp only [CharP.cast_eq_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] at hab
    rw [Ioc_eq_empty (not_lt.2 (Int.floor_mono hab))]; simp
  | succ J ih =>
    intro a b hab
    rw [sum_range_succ']
    simp only [CharP.cast_eq_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add, one_mul]
    have hq' : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
    have hih := ih (a + q) b (by push_cast at hab; linarith)
    have hrw : ∀ j : ℕ, a + q + j * q = a + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * q := fun j => by push_cast; ring
    have hrw2 : ∀ j : ℕ, a + q + (j + 1) * q = a + (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * q := fun j => by
      push_cast; ring
    simp_rw [hrw, hrw2] at hih
    rcases le_or_gt b (a + q) with hb | hb
    · rw [min_eq_right hb]
      have : ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊a + q⌋ ⌊b⌋, G n = 0 := by
        rw [Ioc_eq_empty (not_lt.2 (Int.floor_mono hb))]; simp
      have h0 : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ range J, ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊a + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * q⌋
          ⌊min (a + (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * q) b⌋, G n :=
        sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sum_nonneg fun _ _ => hG _
      linarith
    · rw [min_eq_left hb.le]
      have hsplit : ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊a⌋ ⌊b⌋, G n =
          ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊a⌋ ⌊a + q⌋, G n + ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊a + q⌋ ⌊b⌋, G n := by
        rw [← sum_union (Finset.disjoint_left.2 fun n h1 h2 => by
          simp only [mem_Ioc] at h1 h2; omega)]
        congr 1
        ext n; simp only [mem_Ioc, mem_union]
        have h1 : ⌊a⌋ ≤ ⌊a + q⌋ := Int.floor_mono (by linarith)
        have h2 : ⌊a + q⌋ ≤ ⌊b⌋ := Int.floor_mono hb.le
        omega
      rw [hsplit]; linarith

proof_context.conclusion: Decomposition of the range into blocks of length `q'`.

theorem sep_odd {α Q : ℝ} {a k : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hcop : IsCoprime a (q : ℤ))
    (hα : |2 * α - a / q - k| ≤ 1 / (q * Q)) (hQ : 0 < Q) {m m' : ℤ} (hm : Odd m) (hm' : Odd m')
    (hne : m ≠ m') {K : ℝ} (hK : |((m - m' : ℤ) : ℝ)| / 2 ≤ K) (hKq : K < q) :
    1 / q - K / (q * Q) ≤ |(α * m - α * m') - round (α * m - α * m')| := by
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j : ℤ, m - m' = 2 * j := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hm; obtain ⟨u', hu'⟩ := hm'; exact ⟨u - u', by omega⟩
  have hj0 : j ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hjK : (|j| : ℝ) ≤ K := by
    rw [hj] at hK; push_cast at hK; rw [abs_mul] at hK; norm_num at hK; exact_mod_cast hK
  have hjq : |j| < q := by exact_mod_cast hjK.trans_lt hKq
  have e : α * m - α * m' = 2 * α * j := by
    have : (m : ℝ) - m' = 2 * j := by exact_mod_cast hj
    linear_combination α * this
  rw [e]
  refine le_trans ?_ (dist_two_alpha_mul hq hcop hα hQ hj0 hjq)
  have : (|j| : ℝ) / (q * Q) ≤ K / (q * Q) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hjK (by positivity)
  push_cast at this ⊢; linarith

proof_context.conclusion: For odd m != m' with |m-m'|/2 <= K < q, the distance of alpha(m-m') to the nearest integer is at least 1/q - K/(qQ).

/-- The large sieve (optimal form) for `S(β)`: for `δ`-separated points (`0 < δ ≤ 1`),
`∑_r |S(β_r)|² ≤ (W - W' + δ⁻¹) ∑ (log p)²`. -/
theorem large_sieve_primes {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (β : ι → ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hsep : ∀ r ∈ s, ∀ r' ∈ s, r ≠ r' → δ ≤ |(β r - β r') - round (β r - β r')|)
    {W' W : ℝ} (hW' : 0 ≤ W') :
    ∑ r ∈ s, ‖primeExpSum W' W (β r)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (W - W' + δ⁻¹) * logSqSum W' W := by
  rcases lt_or_ge ⌊W'⌋₊ ⌊W⌋₊ with hlt | hge
  · set M := ⌊W'⌋₊
    set N := ⌊W⌋₊ - M
    have hMN : M + N = ⌊W⌋₊ := by omega
    set a : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => if n.Prime then (Real.log n : ℂ) else 0
    have hS : ∀ t, primeExpSum W' W t = ∑ n ∈ Ioc M (M + N), a n * e (t * n) := by
      intro t
      rw [primeExpSum, hMN, sum_filter]
      refine sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
      simp only [a]; split_ifs <;> simp
    have hL : logSqSum W' W = ∑ n ∈ Ioc M (M + N), ‖a n‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [logSqSum, hMN, sum_filter]
      refine sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
      simp only [a]; split_ifs
      · rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      · simp
    simp_rw [hS]
    rw [hL]
    refine (Prelim.large_sieve_opt s β hδ hδ1 hsep M N a).trans ?_
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have hW0 : 0 ≤ W := by
      by_contra h; push Not at h
      have : ⌊W⌋₊ = 0 := Nat.floor_eq_zero.2 (by linarith)
      omega
    have h1 : (⌊W⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ W := Nat.floor_le hW0
    have h2 : W' < (⌊W'⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one W'
    have hN : (N : ℝ) = ⌊W⌋₊ - ⌊W'⌋₊ := by
      simp only [N, M]; rw [Nat.cast_sub hlt.le]
    rw [hN]; linarith
  · have hempty : Ioc ⌊W'⌋₊ ⌊W⌋₊ = ∅ := Ioc_eq_empty (not_lt.2 hge)
    simp [primeExpSum, logSqSum, hempty]

proof_context.conclusion: Large sieve for prime sums over delta-separated points: sum <= (W-W'+delta^-1) sum (log p)^2.

theorem two_log_le_sub_inv {z : ℝ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) : 2 * Real.log z ≤ z - 1 / z := by
  have hderiv : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → HasDerivAt (fun t => t - 1 / t - 2 * Real.log t)
      (1 + 1 / t ^ 2 - 2 / t) t := by
    intro t ht
    have h := ((hasDerivAt_id' t).sub ((hasDerivAt_inv ht.ne').const_mul 1)).sub
      ((Real.hasDerivAt_log ht.ne').const_mul 2)
    convert h using 1
    · funext s; simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
    · field_simp; ring
  have hmono := monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (f := fun t => t - 1 / t - 2 * Real.log t)
    (convex_Ici 1)
    (fun u hu => (hderiv u (by linarith [Set.mem_Ici.1 hu])).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
    (fun u hu => by
      rw [interior_Ici] at hu
      exact (hderiv u (by linarith [Set.mem_Ioi.1 hu])).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
    (fun u hu => by
      rw [interior_Ici] at hu
      have hu1 : (1 : ℝ) < u := hu
      rw [(hderiv u (by linarith)).deriv]
      have : 1 + 1 / u ^ 2 - 2 / u = (1 - 1 / u) ^ 2 := by field_simp; ring
      rw [this]; positivity)
  have := hmono (Set.mem_Ici.2 le_rfl) (Set.mem_Ici.2 hz) hz
  simp only [div_one, Real.log_one, mul_zero, sub_zero, sub_self] at this
  linarith

proof_context.conclusion: 2 log z <= z-1/z for z>=1, i.e. log(t/2) <= z-1/z.
